_comment: Ratchet baseline for bare `logger.warning(` calls inside src/horosa_skill. A degrade site must call service._degrade(...) so the note reaches envelope.warnings; new bare warnings fail CI. Refresh with `uv run python scripts/verify_silent_degrades.py --update-baseline`.

silent_excepts._comment: Broad excepts that pass / continue / return a constant and call nothing (probes whose None/False is the answer are here on purpose). New ones fail CI; pay down with _degrade.
